draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 169th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 22nd of 30 at LB. He lasted until pick 216, well after his grade rank (169th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (86th percentile). Testing concerns: vertical jump (4th percentile), broad jump (17th percentile). College production: 79 tackles in 2022, 10th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 47 career games and 27 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (8 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 8 (93rd percentile), approximate value 8 (87th percentile), passes defended 5 (85th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 11.4% (20th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 101 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
